scope: Exact full previously audited 229-recipe primitive point grammar on the 24-row recipient, not a general tiling or logical completeness theorem.

point_data.positive_support: One unit at \( (0,r) \). Every finite required row is explicitly active with generation zero. Three global recipient hypothesis citations occupy the declared seed rows; canonical per-definition assumptions never become global hypotheses.
point_data.conclusion_mark: Injective formula value at \( (1,r) \). Assigned value zero is a formula value; absence is unconstrained.
point_data.ordered_mp_marks: For source rows \(a,b<r\), formula marks at \( (1,a),(1,b) \), and signed offset marks \(a-r\) at \( (2,r) \), \(b-r\) at \( (3,r) \). All ordered ports survive even when both use the same source row and formula.
point_data.exterior: All negative formula rows reachable by a raw prototype carry sentinel value \(-1\). Every recipe formula code is nonnegative. Raw prototype alignments with negative references are therefore rejected by point agreement. No geometry test removes them.
point_data.orientation: Identity only; integer vertical translation moves point coordinates and leaves formula codes and signed offsets unchanged.

finite_reduction: Each recipe is kept as a distinct complete witness/interface identity, even when another recipe has the same conclusion formula. Source occurrence aliases are provenance, not extra tile multiplicity.

Fix one unfilled output row and recipe. Check its output formula against all active assigned marks first. A zero-port recipe then has exactly one base candidate. It does not assign either offset port.

For a two-port recipe, form the complete set A of all prior rows compatible with the antecedent formula and assigned first offset, and B for the implication formula and second offset. Untouched positive rows remain eligible references if their marks agree.

Within a candidate, output row is strictly later than either reference, offset ports have different x coordinates, and t has only one point. After the independent output and port filters, the only possible pair interaction is the two formula marks sharing the same source row.

If ordered premise formula codes differ, equal-source pairs conflict and must be removed. If codes agree, repeated equal-source ordered ports remain legal. Hence complete degree contribution is \( |A||B|-|A\cap B| \) for distinct values and \( |A||B| \) for equal values.

Count and iterator visit every recipe in declared inventory order, then each ordered pair in increasing source-row order. For zero/singleton claims the complete factor counts are summed, and currently legal parent-local failed-child keys are subtracted exactly once. A sampled or cluster candidate pool never supplies a degree.

A candidate has exactly one frontier incidence edge of weight one, determined by its output row. Compact keys retain recipe, output translation and all ordered references. Full decorated identities are constructed lazily from exact t/m, source witness, context, registry and authority; equality of output formulas never merges placements.

The dependency index is exact for this grammar: occupied row changes its own domain; an in-bound formula mark at source row s affects its output and every later output; an ordered offset mark affects only its own output. Exterior and other unused mark points have no legal candidate readers under this strict-prior reduction.
transactions_and_execution: Every marking stores value and reference count. The trail records prior absence/value/count, row occupancy, selected compact identity, placed generation, insertion order and local exclusions. Rollback rebuilds only affected complete factors and restores semantic graph state exactly; cumulative work counters are intentionally not rolled back.

The entire frontier is checked for dead rows before any forced row. Any singleton precedes branching. Otherwise earliest generation precedes minimum degree as a tie-break. Unit placements inherit one plus their positive-support point generation; marking distance and proof-row order do not create generations.

The low-level legal placement transaction is a catalog checker. Executor.step additionally requires the current global decision point, and the exact singleton when forced. Cluster hints cannot bypass this action check.

A cluster proposes the compatible union of distinct base keys. Identical shared keys count once, different keys on one row overfill and are rejected. Family input aliases contribute no occupancy. Hints only reprioritize legal candidates incident to the selected point; every remaining base alternative follows in stable complete order.

A failed child is excluded only after finite complete subtree exhaustion, in its exact restored parent. Budget unknown restores state and never supplies an exclusion. Global checks resume after every placement or exclusion. The production target executor remains unrun until a separate reviewed gate.
authority_separation: Exact source-model bytes and the finite independent source/primitive logical audit bind the full production recipe palette. A literal MP AST check rejects internally mark-consistent invalid MP interfaces. Mark consistency alone does not validate axioms or equality templates.

The static structural transport authority stays inactive and is never labeled native_accepted. The point executor does not call or alter the native/compiler engine. A finite point tiling produces only a point certificate pending independent whole logical acceptance.

All 171 family templates can be explicitly bound to primitive rows with all ordered references and actual recipient context; their canonical local seed contexts are not search assumptions. The binder is a proposal API, not a complete embedding enumerator and not a proof-search seed.

The authored 24-row proof is not imported by this kernel or synthetic fixture script. It can later be a read-only independent witness, not a policy word or initial solution. No RL training or new empirical search result is claimed.
